panels.title: Max Reconcile Lag
panels.description: Largest spec-generation gap across the applications in $namespace (the lag gauge is per application and labelled by namespace).

panels.title: Stale Applications
panels.description: Applications whose observed generation is behind their spec generation. Ignores $namespace: the gauge has no namespace label.

panels.title: Releases Stuck
panels.description: Non-terminal releases older than the stuck-release threshold (30 minutes). Ignores $namespace: the gauge has no namespace label.

panels.title: Release Retries Exhausted
panels.description: Applications holding the ReleaseRetriesExhausted condition. Ignores $namespace: the gauge has no namespace label.

panels.title: Out-of-Sync Resources
panels.description: Out-of-sync resources summed over the applications in $namespace. Each application is taken once, so replicated pods do not double-count.

panels.title: Fleet Index Degraded
panels.description: 1 when the installed fleet index health is degraded. Ignores $namespace: the gauge has no namespace label.

panels.title: Applications by Phase
panels.description: Current number of applications in each phase. Ignores $namespace: the gauge has only a phase label. Replicated pods report the same cluster-wide value, so max collapses them.

panels.title: Releases by Phase
panels.description: Current number of releases in each phase. Ignores $namespace: the gauge has only a phase label. Replicated pods report the same cluster-wide value, so max collapses them.

panels.title: Reconcile Rate
panels.description: Controller reconciliations per second. Ignores $namespace: controller-runtime metrics carry no application namespace.

panels.title: Reconcile Error Rate
panels.description: Controller reconcile errors per second. Ignores $namespace: controller-runtime metrics carry no application namespace.

panels.title: P95 Reconcile Latency
panels.description: 95th percentile reconcile duration per controller. Ignores $namespace: controller-runtime metrics carry no application namespace.
